title: Simulate a robot path and sensor readings
description: You sample state transitions and noisy color observations for a sequence of actions.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You choose an initial free cell and build an action sequence from a fixed prefix. Longer sequences append randomly selected actions.
You build transition matrices and store the initial state. Each action selects a new state from the current state's transition probabilities and appends it to true_states.
You read the new cell's color and report it with probability sensor_correct. The other branch chooses a different color label.

steps.question: Why does the supplied action sequence produce a true path length of 17?
steps.answer: true_states includes the initial state before the loop. Each action adds one more state.

steps.description: You use the supplied sensor_correct, p_success, and p_slip values. The recorded output lists the actions and color observations, with a true path length of 17.
